_comment: Second provider — Google DiffusionGemma served by vLLM on the host (W4A16 int4).
_policy: Agentic (tool-calling confirmed via gemma4 parser). W4A16 (compressed-tensors, Marlin int4) verified on RTX 5000 Ada 2026-07-26: ~15GB weights leave ~13GB KV → 128k context. Mutually exclusive with Ollama on the GPU for now — use `gpu-switch diffusion` before testing. See docs/plan/2026-07-22-diffusiongemma-providers-rollout/ and docs/agent-research/2026-07-26-diffusiongemma-int4-quant-hunt/.
_bridge: baseUrl uses the Docker bridge 172.17.0.1 for devcontainers; the installer rewrites the host per environment via DIFFUSION_HOST.
